items.title: Charles Schwab, Robinhood In Or Near Buy Zones But Interactive Brokers Triggers A Sell Signal
items.summary: Charles Schwab stock, along with Robinhood Markets, Ameriprise and LPL Financial, are in or near buy zones in the ongoing stock market action.

items.title: Lululemon Falls on China Business; Tesla Cybercab Service | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Lululemon (LULU) shares are diving as its China business is showing signs of strain, with revenue in mainland China falling 2% in the second quarter after adjusting for currency fluctuations. - Tesla (TSLA) shares are lower on news it formally rolled out the Cybercab for robotaxi service, a long-anticipated step in Elon Musk's effort to push the company away from its roots as an auto manufacturer. The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened a probe into the process and technical data on which Tesla relied when it self-certified the vehicles as compliant with federal safety standards. - Robinhood (HOOD) is down as AMC Entertainment boss Adam Aron criticized Robinhood Markets Inc. after the platform launched a tokenized version of the theater chain's shares.

items.title: AMC CEO threatens SEC complaint over Robinhood tokens
items.summary: Any regulatory action or SEC complaint stemming from Aron's threats would target the platform's rapidly expanding Robinhood Chain token business, which generated over $3.8 million in network revenue on September 1 alone, ranking first among all blockchain networks globally, according to Investing.com market context data.

items.title: AMC Rises 6% as CEO Blasts Tokenized Shares, Robinhood Slips
items.summary: AMC's CEO just called out Robinhood by name in a scorching public attack over tokens tied to his company's stock, and the fallout is splitting two of retail's biggest names in opposite directions on a quiet Friday morning.

items.title: Why AMC Stock Is Jumping After a Big CEO Bust Up With Robinhood
items.summary: AMC’s Adam Aron criticized the online trading platform for its tokenized stocks and demanded that the company stop the trading of AMC stock tokens.  Robinhood stock fell 2.1%.  “What’s the concern?” Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev replied to Aron.

items.title: AMC CEO Slams Robinhood Over 'Inexcusable, Vile' Stock Token Trading
items.summary: AMC CEO takes aim at Robinhood over stock token listings, calls for the broker to remove the offerings. AMC stock jumps.
